ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset open-ended question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Researchers were interested in the effect of temperature on the respiration rate of crickets. Three chambers were prepared and kept at three different temperatures. A cricket was placed in each chamber. The CO2 levels in the chamber were recorded at 0 min, 5 min, and 10 min to assess the changing levels of CO2 over time. This process was repeated 50 times at each temperature. The results are indicated in the figure. Based on the figure, what temperature was associated with the highest respiration rate in the crickets?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a table, titled CO2 levels (ppm ± 2SE). The table lists CO2 levels at 0 min, 5 min, and 10 min by temperature: the 20°C row is 1034, 1074, 1112; the 35°C row is 1560, 1670, 1785; the 50°C row is 2021, 2040, 2051. Reasoning: According to the draft method, use the CO2 level at 10 min minus the CO2 level at 0 min to compare the amount of CO2 increase caused by respiration. 20°C: 1112 - 1034 = 78 ppm; 35°C: 1785 - 1560 = 225 ppm; 50°C: 2051 - 2021 = 30 ppm. The maximum increase is 225 ppm, corresponding to 35°C, therefore the temperature corresponding to the highest respiration rate is 35°C.

method.method_draft: For each temperature in the image table, subtract the 0 min CO2 level from the 10 min CO2 level. Compute increases: 20°C = 1112 - 1034 = 78 ppm, 35°C = 1785 - 1560 = 225 ppm, 50°C = 2051 - 2021 = 30 ppm. The largest increase is at 35°C, so the highest cricket respiration rate was associated with 35°C.

method.method_draft: Compare the CO2 increases over each 5-minute interval for each temperature. From 0 to 5 min: 20°C rises 40 ppm, 35°C rises 110 ppm, and 50°C rises 19 ppm. From 5 to 10 min: 20°C rises 38 ppm, 35°C rises 115 ppm, and 50°C rises 11 ppm. Since 35°C has the largest CO2 increase in both intervals, it has the steepest CO2 accumulation and therefore the highest respiration rate.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个表格，比较了3个温度条件下蟋蟀所在腔室的CO2水平，分别是在0 min、5 min和10 min测得。20°C对应的CO2分别是1034、1074、1112 ppm；35°C对应1560、1670、1785 ppm；50°C对应2021、2040、2051 ppm。
再推理：呼吸速率可看作CO2随时间上升的快慢。计算每个5分钟区间的增加量：20°C从0到5 min增加40 ppm，从5到10 min增加38 ppm；35°C分别增加110 ppm和115 ppm；50°C分别增加19 ppm和11 ppm。35°C在两个时间段里CO2增加都最大，说明其呼吸速率最高。
Final answer: 35
